originalCounterpart: telegram-original-sources/extracted/telegram_iphone.src/Telegraph/Telegraph/TGProfileController.m, TGTelegraphConversationProfileController.mm, TGButtonsMenuItemView.m, TGButtonMenuItemCell.m, TGPhoneItemCell.m, TGContactMediaItemCell.m, TGInterfaceAssets.mm, TGTelegraph.mm, en.lproj/Localizable.strings

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:494-495, 636-655 — the action buttons live inside the tableHeaderView, one full-width 45pt button per row stacked with an 8pt gap, bold 17pt, so the header grows to 86 + n*53pt.
findings.theirs: The actions are a table SECTION (TGActionsSectionTag) holding one TGButtonsMenuItem row 43pt tall, containing up to TWO buttons side by side, each floorf((width-10)/2) wide, bold system 14pt, 0/right-aligned inside the row; the section header is 10pt.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:1934-1941 (actions section), :2322-2323 (return 43 for TGButtonsMenuItemType), :2362-2363 (actions section header 10); TGButtonsMenuItemView.m:127-128 (boldSystemFontOfSize:14), :140-148 (layoutSubviews, two buttons split with a 10pt gutter)
findings.fix: Move the actions out of the header into a real table section placed directly after the phone section. Row height 43. Pair the buttons two-per-row: left = CGRectMake(0,0,floorf((w-10)/2),43), right = CGRectMake(w-buttonWidth,0,buttonWidth,43); single button spans the full content width. Title font [UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:14] (not 17). Section header height 10, footer 1+0.5.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:605-616 actionItems = Call / Video Call / Mute / Search Messages / More; 'Add to contacts' and 'Share contact' are demoted into the More popup (:700-706).
findings.theirs: The two buttons for a Telegram user are 'Send Message' then either 'Add Contact' (if not in the phonebook) or 'Share Contact' (if already a contact). A phonebook-only contact gets one green 'Invite to Telegram' button.
findings.fix: Make the first action row 'Send Message' + 'Add Contact'/'Share Contact' with those exact title-case strings. Keep Call/Video Call (no 2013 counterpart) below them, styled with the same 43pt paired-button row. Disable rather than hide 'Add Contact' when the phone number is empty (alpha 0.7, enabled = NO), as TGButtonsMenuItemView.m:80-82 does.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:1787-1804 supplies titleForHeaderInSection ('3 members', '12 photos and videos', 'Group', 'Channel') and never overrides heightForHeader/FooterInSection, so UIKit draws the big embossed grouped-table caption above each section.
findings.theirs: Neither profile controller implements titleForHeaderInSection at all — the profile has no section captions. Heights are explicit: section 0 = 12 (2 if the phone section is empty), phones = 12, actions = 10, media = 28, default = 12; footer = 0 for phones, otherwise 1 + 0.5 on retina. Group profile: header 8, footer 1 everywhere.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2342-2383 (heightForHeaderInSection / heightForFooterInSection, no titleForHeaderInSection anywhere in the file); TGTelegraphConversationProfileController.mm:1233-1241
findings.fix: Delete tableView:titleForHeaderInSection: for this screen and implement heightForHeaderInSection returning 12 for the first section, 10 for the actions section, 28 for the media section, 12 otherwise (8 for a group profile), and heightForFooterInSection returning 1 + (retina ? 0.5 : 1.0), 0 after the phone/details section.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:1822-1826, 2097-2140 — shared media is a 88pt horizontal thumbnail strip (kStripThumbSide 76 + 2*6 inset) plus a separate per-file list section.
findings.theirs: One 44pt row, title 'Shared Media' in bold system 17 at x=11, and a right-aligned count label in system 17 coloured 0x415d7f at (width-200-11-14, 11, 200, 21), with a loading state (setIsLoading) while the count is being fetched. Thumbnails were compiled out (TG_MEDIA_LIST_SHOW_IMAGES false). Tapping navigates to the media list.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2324-2326 (44), :2605-2609 (setTitle Profile.SharedMedia / setCount / setIsLoading), :2955 (navigateToMediaListOfConversation), TGContactMediaItemCell.m:30-44; en.lproj/Localizable.strings:467; TGProfileController.m:176 (#define TG_MEDIA_LIST_SHOW_IMAGES false)
findings.fix: Replace the strip and file-list sections with a single 44pt 'Shared Media' row: bold 17 title at x=11, count on the right in system 17 / 0x415d7f, spinner while loading, push the media list on tap.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m — no delete-contact section exists anywhere; the only destructive entries are 'Block user'/'Leave group' inside the More popup (:713-718).
findings.theirs: A trailing section with a full-width red button 'Delete Contact' (TGButtonMenuItemSubtypeRedButton), 45pt row, button frame (9,0,width-18,45), bold 17, white title with 0xa10603 alpha 0.5 shadow, shown for every real Telegram-user profile.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2045-2052 (_deleteSection / Profile.DeleteContact red button), :2062-2063 (section appended), :2316-2320 (45pt); TGButtonMenuItemCell.m:29-34, 77-80
findings.fix: Add a last section with a single red 45pt button titled 'Delete Contact' using GroupedActionButtonRed art, title bold 17 white, shadow UIColorRGBA(0xa10603,0.5) offset (0,-1), inset 9 each side.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:2073 — the detail value label is plain black ([UIColor blackColor]) for every row including the phone number.
findings.theirs: The main phone number is drawn in link blue UIColorRGB(0x347fd4); only secondary (non-main) numbers are black, and a hidden number is 0xaaaaaa with the literal text 'Hidden'. A Telegram user's single number always has isMainPhone = true.
findings.citation: TGPhoneItemCell.m:269-283 (setIsMainPhone: 0x347fd4 vs black), :285-292 (setDisabled: 0xaaaaaa + Profile.PhoneHidden); TGProfileController.m:1907-1911 (isMainPhone = true), :1913-1921 (disabled 'empty' phone row); en.lproj/Localizable.strings:451
findings.fix: Colour the 'mobile' row's value UIColorRGB(0x347fd4). When the user exposes no number, still render the row with the value 'Hidden' in UIColorRGB(0xaaaaaa) and userInteractionEnabled = NO instead of omitting it.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:1985-1989 — tapping any detail row copies the value to the pasteboard and shows a 'Copied' toast; there is no dial action and no long-press menu.
findings.theirs: Tapping the phone row opens tel: (falling back to facetime: when tel is unavailable) with [TGStringUtils formatPhoneUrl:]; copying is the UIMenuController 'Copy' action on long press, not the tap.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2938-2950 (tel:/facetime: on didSelectRow), :2814-2826 (performAction copy: via the edit menu)
findings.fix: On tap of the mobile row, openURL tel:<digits> (facetime: if tel cannot be opened). Move copying to shouldShowMenuForRowAtIndexPath/canPerformAction:@selector(copy:) and drop the invented 'Copied' toast.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:500-509 — the avatar view has no gesture recogniser and no userInteractionEnabled; tapping it does nothing.
findings.theirs: The avatar is interactive (userInteractionEnabled = true, exclusiveTouch, a UITapGestureRecognizer) and opens the full-size photo in TGImageViewController with a zoom animation from the avatar's window rect.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:715-721 (avatar tap recogniser), :4340-4372 (animateAppear from the avatar rect into the image viewer)
findings.fix: Set avatarView.userInteractionEnabled = YES, exclusiveTouch = YES, add a tap recogniser that opens the big photo, animating from [avatarView convertRect:bounds toView:window].

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:500-508 — the avatar is a 70x70 UIImageView at x = 9 + retinaPixel with layer.cornerRadius 10 and, when no photo, a hand-drawn coloured initials disc from [TGIcons avatarWithInitials:].
findings.theirs: Frame is exactly CGRectMake(9, 14, 70, 70); the photo is pre-composited by the 'profileAvatar' processor — scaled to 69x69, offset (0.5, 0) inside a 70x70 canvas, corner radius 10, with the ProfileAvatarOverlay.png bevel drawn on top. The empty state is the shipped art ProfilePhotoPlaceholder.png, never letters.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:715 (CGRectMake(9,14,70,70)), :1730-1733 (placeholder profileAvatarPlaceholderEmpty), TGTelegraph.mm:503-504 (69x69, offset 0.5, radius 10, profileAvatarOverlay), TGInterfaceAssets.mm:442-447 and :471-476 (ProfileAvatarOverlay.png / ProfilePhotoPlaceholder.png)
findings.fix: Use x = 9 exactly (drop TGProfileRetinaPixel from the origin) and move the half-pixel into the image composite: draw the photo at 69x69 offset (0.5,0) in a 70x70 context with radius 10, then overlay ProfileAvatarOverlay@2x.png. Copy ProfileAvatarOverlay@2x.png and ProfilePhotoPlaceholder@2x.png from the original Resources into images/ and use the placeholder art instead of TGIcons initials.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:216 — self.title = @"Info" unconditionally, for users and for groups alike.
findings.theirs: A user profile is titled 'Info' (Profile.Title), a group profile is titled 'Group Info' (ConversationProfile.Title), and a secret chat is 'Secret Chat' with three leading spaces to leave room for the lock glyph.
findings.fix: Title = 'Group Info' when chatId is a group/channel, '   Secret Chat' for a secret chat, 'Info' only for a one-to-one user profile.

findings.ours: src/TGProfileViewController.m:1813-1820 — an invented empty-state footer 'Nothing shared here yet.' and a story footer 'Everyone you allow sees it for 24 hours.'
findings.theirs: The only comment text under a profile section is the actions comment, and even that is shown only when a contact request is pending: 'To exchange phone numbers you can send a contact request' / 'You have sent a contact request'. There is no empty-state caption for media.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:1096-1098 (the two comment strings), :1101-1105 (only appended when showComment)
findings.fix: Drop the 'Nothing shared here yet.' footer — the Shared Media row simply shows a count of 0. If a comment is needed under the action buttons, use the original's TGCommentMenuItem strings verbatim.
